pages.text: Illager bosses are fought with their armies. They are the social tier: a squad of recruits and a friend are the intended answer.$(br2)The Invoker and the totem captains of Respillaged all hold the $(l:patchouli:tech/tier2)Tier 2$() Trading Floor.
The Invoker in the Illager Fort. Shields itself, calls fangs, blinks. Kill the fort's garrison first or it never ends. Holds the $(bold)Trading Floor$().
Necromancers raise the dead you have already killed. In a raid they are the first target. Not a boss, but the reason raids end badly.

$(bold)Totem captains$() (Illage & Spillage, Respillaged): summoned with totems looted from outposts. Spellcasters and brutes with phases. They are summonable, so a full server never waits on worldgen for them.$(br2)They hold the richest loot in the pack, and the illagers' stolen ledgers: any of them can drop the $(bold)Trading Floor$() Blueprint.
